source.explanation: Task deliver-goods-1 requires one completed alternative branch before it can occur.
Tasks cancel-order and send-payment-proof are first observable tasks in alternative branches of gateway Gateway_12czfr6.
Tasks release-shipment and send-tracking-link are first observable tasks in alternative branches of gateway Gateway_1arwctf.
Task release-shipment is the first task on a guarded exclusive branch and requires the guard information.
Task send-tracking-link is the first task on a guarded exclusive branch and requires the guard information.
Task send-tracking-link is not enabled until request-shipment-3 has occurred.
Task cancel-order is not enabled until send-invoice has occurred.
Task request-shipment-1 is not enabled until send-payment-proof has occurred.
Task request-shipment-2 is not enabled until send-payment-proof has occurred.
